transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work lately. My head isn't really clear. I keep... losing track of what my clients are saying. And I'll just sit there rereading the same chart note over and over. I just kind of freeze up on simple decisions I usually handle fine. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't exactly noticed feeling sad. It's mostly just... what I said about work. Just not being able to think straight.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
Um... no, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed feeling anxious. Just... mostly what I said before.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

I guess... maybe. Um... my guitar has just been sitting in the corner lately. And I keep bailing on soccer, and... the shelter. I don't know. Even when I try to do things I usually like, like cook or go hiking... it just feels like I'm going through the motions. Like there's no point to it. So... yeah. I guess so.
How long have you been feeling like you're just going through the motions?

Um... probably about a month. It started around the time the clinic lost some staff. They shifted my schedule to... late-evening coverage. And I've had to do a lot heavier crisis paperwork. So... yeah, since then, I guess.
Do you feel sad or empty inside most of the day?
I don't know... I haven't really thought about it. I don't think I feel sad, exactly. Just... I don't know. I haven't really noticed.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?

Um... I guess so. My pants are kind of loose lately. I just... I don't really feel hungry most days. Not unless someone actually reminds me to eat. I guess I've just been... skipping meals without really meaning to. So, yeah.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
I... I think I just said, I don't really feel sad. Just... I don't know. I'm not really paying attention to it, I guess.
Do you enjoy things as much as you used to?

Um... I guess not. I haven't really been doing much. My guitar is just... sitting in the corner. And I keep bailing on soccer, and the shelter. Even when I actually try to do something, like cook or go hiking... I don't know, it just feels like I'm going through the motions. Like there's no point to it.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
I... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said, no. Not really sad. Just... I don't know. I'm not really feeling much of anything.
Do you take pleasure in things that you used to enjoy?

I... you just asked me this one, too. 

Like I said... no. I'm not playing my guitar, I keep skipping soccer and the shelter... even cooking or hiking just feels like I'm going through the motions. There's just no point to it.
Do you feel depressed?

I don't know. I feel like you're just asking me the same thing again. 

Like I said, I'm not crying all the time or feeling sad. So... probably not? I just don't really feel much of anything right now.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure?

I... yeah. I mean, I feel like I just answered this. Like I said a minute ago, my guitar is just sitting in the corner. I keep bailing on soccer and the shelter. Even if I try to cook or go hiking, it just feels like going through the motions. There's just no point to it. I don't really know how many different ways I can say it.
Do you feel like you're a sad person?

No. I... we just went over this. 

Like I said, I don't feel sad. I'm not a sad person. I just... I don't really feel much of anything. I don't know why we keep going in circles here.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities that usually bring you pleasure?

I... are you even listening to me? I just told you all of this. 

The guitar, soccer, the shelter... I keep bailing on all of it. And like I said, even if I try cooking or hiking, it's just going through the motions. There's no point to any of it. I really don't know what else you want me to say about it.
Do you ever feel sad or empty inside?

I... look, I already said I'm not sad. And empty... I don't know. I don't really know what you mean by that. I just... I don't have anything else to add to this. Are we going to just keep asking the same things?
Can you think of any times recently when you have felt sad?
No. I can't. Like I keep saying... I don't feel sad. I just don't feel anything. I don't know how many different ways I can say it.
Do you feel like you're depressed most days?
I don't know. I don't really know what you mean by depressed. I just... like I said, I don't feel anything. Most days are just... blank, I guess. I don't know what else to call it.
Do you feel like you're depressed?
I... didn't you just ask me that? I really don't know. Like I just said, I wouldn't call it that. I just... I don't feel like anything.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I guess. My pants are a little loose. I just... I don't really feel hungry most days. Usually someone has to remind me to eat, so I guess I've been skipping meals. Not on purpose, though.
